purpose: Pharmacy career and competitive-exam preparation catalogue. Exam schemes and eligibility must be versioned from the latest official recruiting/competent-authority notice before publishing preparation content.

tracks.name: Railway Pharmacist
tracks.rule: Use the latest RRB Pharmacist recruitment notice/CEN as the authoritative exam pattern, eligibility, vacancies and syllabus. Do not assume an old CEN remains current.

tracks.name: D.Pharm Exit Examination
tracks.authority: Pharmacy Council of India / prescribed authority
tracks.official_basis: Diploma in Pharmacy Exit Examination Regulations, 2022
tracks.rule: Version all preparation content against the latest PCI scheme/syllabus announcement.

tracks.name: Drug Inspector / Drugs Inspector recruitment
tracks.rule: Separate central and state recruitment notices. Eligibility, scheme, syllabus and subject weightage are notice-specific.

tracks.name: Drug Analyst / Government pharmaceutical analysis posts
tracks.rule: Separate each recruitment authority/notice; do not create a single universal syllabus unless an authority explicitly provides one.

tracks.name: Government Pharmacist examinations
tracks.rule: Create authority-specific preparation tracks from official notifications.

content_strategy.common_core: Map common pharmacy concepts from approved B.Pharm/D.Pharm curriculum into reusable preparation modules.
content_strategy.exam_layer: Add exam-specific questions, laws, current rules, aptitude/general sections and weighting only when supported by the current official notice.
